fusions.name: Pulled Threads
fusions.desc: Shreds a cone 2 tiles long with your claws, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Batted Yarn
fusions.desc: Bats a tangle of thread at the first enemy in line for 7 damage, wrapping it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Draped Shadow
fusions.desc: You and your allies are veiled for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Prowler's Mantle
fusions.desc: You wear a woven mantle that raises your dodge chance by 6% and your armour by 5%, and takes 1 damage off every hit you take.
